front_matter.title: Building blocks
front_matter.description: Every building block of Orchard, by layer, with the blocks it depends on.
front_matter.lede: 6 blocks in 4 layers. Each block is a contract of commands, events and views.

markdown:
:::warning[Private pack]

This page is of a private pack. It is not for publication.

:::

The blocks declare 5 entities, 10 commands and 10 events. An arrow points from a block to a block it depends on; point at a block to see what it uses and what uses it.

<LayerMap data={page.data["map"]} presentation={site.presentation} />

## Every block

| layer | block | what it is | depends on | KPIs |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **3** yield | [harvest](./3-yield/harvest.mdx) | The fruit of one tree in one season. | [tree](./1-soil/tree.mdx) | 1 |
| **2** hands | [basket](./2-hands/basket.mdx) | What one picker fills; one exists for each picker. | [picker](./2-hands/picker.mdx) | 1 |
|  | [picker](./2-hands/picker.mdx) | A hand that picks fruit in a grove. | [grove](./1-soil/grove.mdx) | 0 |
| **1** soil | [tree](./1-soil/tree.mdx) | One tree of a grove. | [grove](./1-soil/grove.mdx) | 0 |
|  | [grove](./1-soil/grove.mdx) | A planted piece of land. | – | 1 |
| **0** seed | [seedbank](./0-seed/seedbank.mdx) | Identifiers of every entity of the orchard blocks. | – | 0 |

## Planned blocks

The KPI catalogue names no block beyond these. [Planned blocks](./planned.mdx) lists a block once it does.
